verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a Create Custom Control API alongside adding controls from the Vanta library, mapping documents to controls, and Custom Tests that turn pushed custom-resource data into pass/fail evidence. Custom frameworks are only implied by marketing copy about cross-mapping across pre-built frameworks "or ones you've customized", with no documented way to create a new framework from scratch. missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating a brand-new custom framework, detailed docs on defining evidence requirements per custom control, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones

citations.quote: Add a control from the Vanta library to your organization's controls.
Add a document to a control.
turn that data into pass/fail evidence with a Custom Test
you can cross-map your controls across [frameworks_count] pre-built frameworks (or ones you've customized)
Deactivates a custom or Vanta control.
